description: Run SQL against a database through DataRobot with a JDBC URL (or host, port, and database) and credentials you supply; no DataRobot data connection needed. Also use it to point an existing app such as Talk to My Data at DataRobot's low-latency /jdbcDataPreview/ route (/jdbcExecution/ only for user-approved writes). Use when the user wants to test a connection to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Snowflake, Databricks, Trino, SAP HANA or Datasphere, Redshift, or BigQuery, list tables or columns, run read queries, or run DML/DDL, e.g. "run this SQL on jdbc:postgresql://… through DataRobot". If the database is already a DataRobot data connection, use datarobot-connectivity-datastore-sql.
